#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compute count, mean, and median of the numbers in data.txt (one per line)."""

from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, median

here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
numbers = [float(line) for line in (here / "data.txt").read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]

(here / "stats.txt").write_text(
    f"count: {len(numbers)}\n"
    f"mean: {mean(numbers)}\n"
    f"median: {median(numbers)}\n"
)
